def page_decorator(title: str):
    def draw(canvas_obj, doc):
        canvas_obj.saveState()
        canvas_obj.setStrokeColor(colors.HexColor("#dce3ee"))
        canvas_obj.setLineWidth(0.5)
        canvas_obj.line(doc.leftMargin, A4[1] - 20 * mm, A4[0] - doc.rightMargin, A4[1] - 20 * mm)
        canvas_obj.line(doc.leftMargin, 14 * mm, A4[0] - doc.rightMargin, 14 * mm)
        canvas_obj.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 10)
        canvas_obj.setFillColor(colors.HexColor("#14213d"))
        canvas_obj.drawString(doc.leftMargin, A4[1] - 16 * mm, title)
        canvas_obj.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
        canvas_obj.setFillColor(colors.HexColor("#5f6f86"))
        canvas_obj.drawRightString(A4[0] - doc.rightMargin, A4[1] - 16 * mm, f"Generated {GENERATED_AT}")
        canvas_obj.drawRightString(A4[0] - doc.rightMargin, 9 * mm, f"Page {canvas_obj.getPageNumber()}")
        canvas_obj.restoreState()
    return draw


def build_image(path: Path):
    image = RLImage(str(path))
    max_width = 170 * mm
    max_height = 96 * mm
    scale = min(max_width / image.imageWidth, max_height / image.imageHeight, 1)
    image.drawWidth = image.imageWidth * scale
    image.drawHeight = image.imageHeight * scale
    image.hAlign = "CENTER"
    return image


def markdown_to_story(markdown_text: str, document_title: str, base_dir: Path):
    styles = build_styles()
    story = [Paragraph(escape(document_title), styles["title"]), Paragraph(f"Generated {GENERATED_AT}", styles["meta"])]
    lines = markdown_text.splitlines()
    paragraph_buffer: list[str] = []
    in_code = False
    code_lines: list[str] = []

    def flush_paragraph():
        nonlocal paragraph_buffer
        if paragraph_buffer:
            text = " ".join(line.strip() for line in paragraph_buffer).strip()
            if text:
                story.append(Paragraph(escape(text), styles["body"]))
            paragraph_buffer = []

    def flush_code():
        nonlocal code_lines
        if code_lines:
            story.append(Preformatted("\n".join(code_lines), styles["code"]))
            code_lines = []

    for raw_line in lines:
        line = raw_line.rstrip()
        stripped = line.strip()

        if stripped.startswith("```"):
            flush_paragraph()
            if in_code:
                flush_code()
                in_code = False
            else:
                in_code = True
            continue

        if in_code:
            code_lines.append(line)
            continue

        if not stripped:
            flush_paragraph()
            story.append(Spacer(1, 4))
            continue

        image_match = IMAGE_PATTERN.match(stripped)
        if image_match:
            flush_paragraph()
            alt_text = image_match.group("alt").strip() or "Snapshot"
            image_path = (base_dir / image_match.group("path").strip()).resolve()
            if image_path.exists():
                story.append(build_image(image_path))
                story.append(Spacer(1, 4))
                story.append(Paragraph(escape(alt_text), styles["caption"]))
            else:
                story.append(Paragraph(f"[Missing image: {escape(image_match.group('path'))}]", styles["meta"]))
            continue

        if stripped.startswith("# "):
            flush_paragraph()
            story.append(Paragraph(escape(stripped[2:].strip()), styles["h1"]))
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("## "):
            flush_paragraph()
            story.append(Paragraph(escape(stripped[3:].strip()), styles["h2"]))
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("### "):
            flush_paragraph()
            story.append(Paragraph(escape(stripped[4:].strip()), styles["h3"]))
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("- "):
            flush_paragraph()
            story.append(Paragraph(f"&bull; {escape(stripped[2:].strip())}", styles["bullet"]))
            continue
        if re.match(r"^\d+\.\s+", stripped):
            flush_paragraph()
            story.append(Paragraph(escape(stripped), styles["bullet"]))
            continue

        paragraph_buffer.append(stripped)

    flush_paragraph()
    flush_code()
    return story


def render_markdown_pdf(markdown_path: Path, pdf_path: Path, title: str):
    text = markdown_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    story = markdown_to_story(text, title, markdown_path.parent)
    doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
        str(pdf_path),
        pagesize=A4,
        leftMargin=18 * mm,
        rightMargin=18 * mm,
        topMargin=26 * mm,
        bottomMargin=18 * mm,
        title=title,
        author="OpenAI Codex",
    )
    decorator = page_decorator(title)
    doc.build(story, onFirstPage=decorator, onLaterPages=decorator)


def iter_source_files():
    files = []
    for path in ROOT.rglob("*"):
        if path.is_dir():
            continue
        rel_parts = path.relative_to(ROOT).parts
        if any(part in EXCLUDED_DIRS for part in rel_parts):
            continue
        if path.name in EXCLUDED_FILE_NAMES:
            continue
        if path.suffix.lower() not in INCLUDED_EXTENSIONS:
            continue
        files.append(path)
    return sorted(files, key=lambda item: item.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())


def build_source_export() -> str:
    lines = [
        "POS IMS SOURCE CODE EXPORT",
        f"Generated: {GENERATED_AT}",
        "Included roots: manage.py, possumus, pos, accounts, api, docs text sources, and related text assets.",
        "Excluded: .git, .venv, company_logos uploads, generated PDFs, generated source export text.",
        "",
    ]

    for path in iter_source_files():
        relative = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        lines.append("=" * 110)
        lines.append(f"FILE: {relative}")
        lines.append("=" * 110)
        try:
            body = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except OSError as exc:
            body = f"[Unable to read file: {exc}]"
        lines.append(body.rstrip("\n"))
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def render_code_pdf(text_content: str, pdf_path: Path, title: str):
    pdf = canvas.Canvas(str(pdf_path), pagesize=landscape(A4))
    width, height = landscape(A4)
    left = 12 * mm
    right = 12 * mm
    top = 12 * mm
    bottom = 12 * mm
    line_height = 8.2
    wrap_width = 150
    page_number = 1

    def start_page():
        pdf.setStrokeColor(colors.HexColor("#dce3ee"))
        pdf.setLineWidth(0.5)
        pdf.line(left, height - top - 6, width - right, height - top - 6)
        pdf.line(left, bottom - 4, width - right, bottom - 4)
        pdf.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 10)
        pdf.setFillColor(colors.HexColor("#14213d"))
        pdf.drawString(left, height - top + 4, title)
        pdf.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
        pdf.setFillColor(colors.HexColor("#5f6f86"))
        pdf.drawRightString(width - right, height - top + 4, f"Generated {GENERATED_AT}")
        pdf.drawRightString(width - right, bottom - 1, f"Page {page_number}")
        pdf.setFont("Courier", 6.5)
        pdf.setFillColor(colors.black)
        return height - top - 18

    y = start_page()

    for raw_line in text_content.splitlines():
        expanded = raw_line.replace("\t", "    ")
        wrapped = textwrap.wrap(
            expanded,
            width=wrap_width,
            replace_whitespace=False,
            drop_whitespace=False,
            break_long_words=True,
            break_on_hyphens=False,
        ) or [""]
        for line in wrapped:
            if y <= bottom + 8:
                pdf.showPage()
                page_number += 1
                y = start_page()
            pdf.drawString(left, y, line)
            y -= line_height

    pdf.save()


def main():
    DOCS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    render_markdown_pdf(HOW_TO_PATH, HOW_TO_PDF, "How to Use POS IMS")
    render_markdown_pdf(FULL_DOC_PATH, FULL_DOC_PDF, "POS IMS Full Documentation")
    render_markdown_pdf(TUTORIAL_PATH, TUTORIAL_PDF, "POS IMS Step-by-Step Tutorial")
    source_export = build_source_export()
    CODE_TXT.write_text(source_export, encoding="utf-8")
    render_code_pdf(source_export, CODE_PDF, "POS IMS Source Code")
    print(f"Created: {HOW_TO_PDF}")
    print(f"Created: {FULL_DOC_PDF}")
    print(f"Created: {TUTORIAL_PDF}")
    print(f"Created: {CODE_TXT}")
    print(f"Created: {CODE_PDF}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
function getCsrfToken() {
    const match = document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/);
    return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : '';
}

function buildStatementUrl() {
    const from = document.getElementById('from_date').value;
    const to = document.getElementById('to_date').value;
    let url = `/api/party-statement/?customer_id=1`;
    if (from) url += `&from=${from}`;
    if (to) url += `&to=${to}`;
    return url;
}

function loadStatement() {
    fetch(buildStatementUrl())
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            document.getElementById('closing_balance').innerText = `Rs ${data.closing_balance}`;
            const badge = document.getElementById('balance_badge');
            badge.className = `status-chip ${data.balance_type}`;
            badge.innerText = data.balance_type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
            const body = document.getElementById('ledger');
            body.innerHTML = '';
            data.rows.forEach(row => {
                body.innerHTML += `<tr>
                    <td>${row.date}</td>
                    <td>${row.voucher_type} #${row.voucher_id}</td>
                    <td>${row.ref}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.debit}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.credit}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.display_balance}</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
        });
}

function toggleBankLedger() {
    const method = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const wrap = document.getElementById('bank-ledger-wrap');
    wrap.classList.toggle('d-none', method !== 'bank');
}

function openSettlement() {
    toggleBankLedger();
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('settlementModal')).show();
}

function submitSettlement() {
    const method = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const payload = {
        customer_id: 1,
        amount: document.getElementById('amount').value,
        payment_method: method,
    };
    if (method === 'bank') {
        payload.bank_account_id = document.getElementById('bank_account_id').value;
    }

    fetch('/api/settlements/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': getCsrfToken(),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) {
            const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            throw new Error(data.error || 'Settlement could not be saved.');
        }
        window.location.reload();
    })
    .catch((error) => alert(error.message));
}

loadStatement();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    const form = document.getElementById("customer-search-form");
    const input = document.getElementById("customer-search-input");
    if (!form || !input) return;
    let timer = null;
    input.addEventListener("input", function () {
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = window.setTimeout(function () {
            form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.submit();
        }, 250);
    });
})();
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('salesTrendChart');
    if (!canvas) {
        return;
    }

    new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: ['03 Mar', '04 Mar', '05 Mar', '06 Mar', '07 Mar', '08 Mar', '09 Mar'],
            datasets: [
                {
                    label: 'Net Sales',
                    data: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 49.0, 69.4, 95020.0],
                    borderColor: 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 1)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.14)',
                    fill: true,
                    tension: 0.35,
                    borderWidth: 3,
                    pointRadius: 3,
                    pointHoverRadius: 5,
                },
                {
                    label: 'Gross Profit',
                    data: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 18.0, 15.4, 5005.0],
                    borderColor: 'rgba(22, 163, 74, 1)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.10)',
                    fill: false,
                    tension: 0.35,
                    borderWidth: 3,
                    pointRadius: 3,
                    pointHoverRadius: 5,
                }
            ]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
            layout: {
                padding: { top: 8, right: 8, left: 0, bottom: 0 }
            },
            plugins: {
                legend: {
                    position: 'bottom',
                    labels: { usePointStyle: true, boxWidth: 10 }
                }
            },
            scales: {
                x: {
                    grid: { display: false }
                },
                y: {
                    beginAtZero: true,
                    grid: { color: 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18)' },
                    ticks: {
                        maxTicksLimit: 6,
                        callback: function(value) {
                            return 'Rs ' + value;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
})();
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    const barcodeInput = document.getElementById('barcode-input');
    const productSearchInput = document.getElementById('product-search-input');
    const productSearchMeta = document.getElementById('product-search-meta');
    const productCards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.js-product-card'));
    const productSearchEmpty = document.getElementById('product-search-empty');
    const discountInput = document.getElementById('discount_rate');
    const taxInput = document.getElementById('tax_rate');
    const subtotalSpan = document.getElementById('subtotal-amount');
    const discountSpan = document.getElementById('discount-amount');
    const taxSpan = document.getElementById('tax-amount');
    const totalSpan = document.getElementById('final-total');
    const creditBox = document.getElementById('is_credit');
    const paymentMethod = document.getElementById('payment_method');
    const customerSelect = document.getElementById('customer_id');
    const customerHidden = document.getElementById('selected_customer_id_hidden');
    const bankSelect = document.getElementById('bank_account_id');
    const bankWrapper = document.getElementById('bank-account-wrapper');
    const preserveForms = document.querySelectorAll('.js-preserve-form');
    const cartLines = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cart-line'));
    const manualTaxEnabled = true;
    const usesCategoryGst = false;
    const inlineEditors = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-inline-pricing]'));

    function filterProducts() {
        if (!productSearchInput || !productCards.length) return;
        const term = productSearchInput.value.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        const parts = term ? term.split(' ').filter(Boolean) : [];
        let visibleCount = 0;
        const totalCount = productCards.length;

        productCards.forEach(function (card) {
            const haystack = (card.dataset.productSearch || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            const visible = !parts.length || parts.every(function (part) {
                return haystack.indexOf(part) !== -1;
            });
            card.classList.toggle('d-none', !visible);
            if (visible) visibleCount += 1;
        });

        if (productSearchEmpty) {
            productSearchEmpty.classList.toggle('d-none', visibleCount !== 0);
        }

        if (productSearchMeta) {
            productSearchMeta.textContent = term
                ? `Showing ${visibleCount} of ${totalCount} product${totalCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} while you type.`
                : `Showing all ${totalCount} available product${totalCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`;
        }
    }

    function validateInlinePricing(form) {
        const priceField = form.querySelector('[data-price-input]');
        const discountField = form.querySelector('[data-discount-input]');
        if (!priceField || !discountField) return true;
        const minimumValue = parseFloat(priceField.dataset.minimum || discountField.dataset.minimum || '0') || 0;
        const priceValue = parseFloat(priceField.value || '0') || 0;
        const discountValue = Math.min(Math.max(parseFloat(discountField.value || '0') || 0, 0), 100);
        const effectiveValue = priceValue - (priceValue * (discountValue / 100));
        const invalid = minimumValue > 0 && effectiveValue + 0.0001 < minimumValue;
        const message = invalid ? 'Below allowed pricing rule.' : '';
        priceField.setCustomValidity(message);
        discountField.setCustomValidity(message);
        return !invalid;
    }

    if (barcodeInput) {
        barcodeInput.focus();
        barcodeInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (event.key !== 'Enter') return;
            event.preventDefault();
            const code = barcodeInput.value.trim();
            if (!code) return;
            fetch(`/pos/ajax/scan/${encodeURIComponent(code)}/`)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.status === 'ok') {
                        window.location.reload();
                        return;
                    }
                    if (data.status === 'out_of_stock') {
                        alert(`${data.product} is out of stock for additional quantity.`);
                        return;
                    }
                    alert('Product not found.');
                });
            barcodeInput.value = '';
        });
    }

    function recalcTotal() {
        if (!subtotalSpan || !discountSpan || !taxSpan || !totalSpan) return;
        const rows = cartLines.map((line) => ({
            lineTotal: parseFloat(line.dataset.lineTotal) || 0,
            taxRate: parseFloat(line.dataset.taxRate) || 0,
        }));
        const subtotal = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.lineTotal, 0);
        let discountRate = parseFloat(discountInput ? discountInput.value : 0) || 0;
        let manualTaxRate = parseFloat(taxInput ? taxInput.value : 0) || 0;
        discountRate = Math.min(Math.max(discountRate, 0), 100);
        manualTaxRate = Math.min(Math.max(manualTaxRate, 0), 100);
        const discountAmount = subtotal * (discountRate / 100);
        const afterDiscount = subtotal - discountAmount;
        let taxAmount = 0;

        if (usesCategoryGst && subtotal > 0) {
            let remainingDiscount = discountAmount;
            rows.forEach((row, index) => {
                let allocatedDiscount = remainingDiscount;
                if (index < rows.length - 1) {
                    allocatedDiscount = Number((discountAmount * (row.lineTotal / subtotal)).toFixed(2));
                    remainingDiscount -= allocatedDiscount;
                }
                const taxableBase = Math.max(row.lineTotal - allocatedDiscount, 0);
                taxAmount += taxableBase * (row.taxRate / 100);
            });
        } else if (manualTaxEnabled) {
            taxAmount = afterDiscount * (manualTaxRate / 100);
        }

        subtotalSpan.textContent = subtotal.toFixed(2);
        discountSpan.textContent = discountAmount.toFixed(2);
        taxSpan.textContent = taxAmount.toFixed(2);
        totalSpan.textContent = (afterDiscount + taxAmount).toFixed(2);
    }

    function syncPreservedState(form) {
        const customerField = form.querySelector('input[name="selected_customer_id"]');
        const creditField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_credit"]');
        const paymentField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_payment_method"]');
        const bankField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_bank_account_id"]');
        const discountField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_discount_rate"]');
        const taxField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_tax_rate"]');
        if (customerField && customerSelect) customerField.value = customerSelect.value;
        if (creditField && creditBox) creditField.value = creditBox.checked ? '1' : '0';
        if (paymentField && paymentMethod) paymentField.value = paymentMethod.value;
        if (bankField && bankSelect) bankField.value = bankSelect.value;
        if (discountField && discountInput) discountField.value = discountInput.value;
        if (taxField && taxInput) taxField.value = taxInput.value;
    }

    function syncCheckoutCustomer() {
        if (customerHidden && customerSelect) customerHidden.value = customerSelect.value;
    }

    function toggleBankField() {
        if (!bankWrapper || !paymentMethod) return;
        const usingBank = paymentMethod.value === 'bank';
        const creditSale = creditBox && creditBox.checked;
        bankWrapper.style.display = usingBank && !creditSale ? '' : 'none';
        if ((!usingBank || creditSale) && bankSelect) bankSelect.value = '';
    }

    preserveForms.forEach(function (form) {
        form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
            syncPreservedState(form);
        });
    });

    inlineEditors.forEach(function (form) {
        const priceField = form.querySelector('[data-price-input]');
        const discountField = form.querySelector('[data-discount-input]');
        let submitTimer = null;

        const scheduleSubmit = function () {
            if (!validateInlinePricing(form)) return;
            window.clearTimeout(submitTimer);
            submitTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
                form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.submit();
            }, 450);
        };

        const flushSubmit = function () {
            if (!validateInlinePricing(form)) return;
            window.clearTimeout(submitTimer);
            form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.submit();
        };

        if (priceField && !priceField.readOnly) {
            priceField.addEventListener('input', scheduleSubmit);
            priceField.addEventListener('blur', flushSubmit);
        }
        if (discountField && !discountField.readOnly) {
            discountField.addEventListener('input', scheduleSubmit);
            discountField.addEventListener('blur', flushSubmit);
        }
        form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
            if (!validateInlinePricing(form)) {
                event.preventDefault();
            }
        });
        validateInlinePricing(form);
    });

    if (paymentMethod) paymentMethod.addEventListener('change', toggleBankField);
    if (creditBox) creditBox.addEventListener('change', toggleBankField);
    if (customerSelect) customerSelect.addEventListener('change', syncCheckoutCustomer);
    if (discountInput) discountInput.addEventListener('input', recalcTotal);
    if (taxInput) taxInput.addEventListener('input', recalcTotal);
    if (productSearchInput) {
        productSearchInput.addEventListener('input', filterProducts);
        productSearchInput.addEventListener('search', filterProducts);
    }

    syncCheckoutCustomer();
    toggleBankField();
    recalcTotal();
    filterProducts();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    const form = document.getElementById("product-filter-form");
    if (!form) return;
    const queryInput = document.getElementById("q");
    const liveSelects = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll("select"));
    let timer = null;

    function submitForm() {
        form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.submit();
    }

    if (queryInput) {
        queryInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
            window.clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = window.setTimeout(submitForm, 250);
        });
    }

    liveSelects.forEach(function (field) {
        field.addEventListener("change", submitForm);
    });
})();
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    (function () {
        const modeField = document.getElementById("id_adjustment_mode");
        const reasonField = document.getElementById("id_reason_preset");
        const customReasonField = document.getElementById("id_custom_reason");
        const deltaWrap = document.querySelector(".quantity-delta-wrap");
        const afterWrap = document.querySelector(".quantity-after-wrap");
        const customWrap = document.querySelector(".custom-reason-wrap");

        function syncStockAdjustmentUi() {
            const mode = modeField ? modeField.value : "";
            const reason = reasonField ? reasonField.value : "";

            if (deltaWrap) {
                deltaWrap.style.display = mode === "stock_take" ? "none" : "block";
            }
            if (afterWrap) {
                afterWrap.style.display = mode === "stock_take" ? "block" : "none";
            }
            if (customWrap) {
                customWrap.style.display = reason === "other" ? "block" : "none";
            }
            if (mode === "stock_take" && reasonField && !reasonField.value) {
                reasonField.value = "stock_take_difference";
            }
            if (reason !== "other" && customReasonField) {
                customReasonField.value = customReasonField.value || "";
            }
        }

        if (modeField) {
            modeField.addEventListener("change", syncStockAdjustmentUi);
        }
        if (reasonField) {
            reasonField.addEventListener("change", syncStockAdjustmentUi);
        }
        syncStockAdjustmentUi();
    })();
</script>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
function getCsrfToken() {
    const match = document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/);
    return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : '';
}

function buildStatementUrl() {
    const from = document.getElementById('from_date').value;
    const to = document.getElementById('to_date').value;
    let url = `/api/party-statement/?supplier_id=1`;
    if (from) url += `&from=${from}`;
    if (to) url += `&to=${to}`;
    return url;
}

function loadStatement() {
    fetch(buildStatementUrl())
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            document.getElementById('closing_balance').innerText = `Rs ${data.closing_balance}`;
            const badge = document.getElementById('balance_badge');
            badge.className = `status-chip ${data.balance_type}`;
            badge.innerText = data.balance_type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
            const body = document.getElementById('ledger');
            body.innerHTML = '';
            data.rows.forEach(row => {
                body.innerHTML += `<tr>
                    <td>${row.date}</td>
                    <td>${row.voucher_type} #${row.voucher_id}</td>
                    <td>${row.ref}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.debit}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.credit}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.display_balance}</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
        });
}

function toggleBankLedger() {
    const method = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const wrap = document.getElementById('bank-ledger-wrap');
    wrap.classList.toggle('d-none', method !== 'bank');
}

function openSettlement() {
    toggleBankLedger();
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('settlementModal')).show();
}

function submitSettlement() {
    const method = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const payload = {
        supplier_id: 1,
        amount: document.getElementById('amount').value,
        payment_method: method,
    };
    if (method === 'bank') {
        payload.bank_account_id = document.getElementById('bank_account_id').value;
    }

    fetch('/api/settlements/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': getCsrfToken(),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) {
            const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            throw new Error(data.error || 'Settlement could not be saved.');
        }
        window.location.reload();
    })
    .catch((error) => alert(error.message));
}

loadStatement();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    const form = document.getElementById("supplier-search-form");
    const input = document.getElementById("supplier-search-input");
    if (!form || !input) return;
    let timer = null;
    input.addEventListener("input", function () {
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = window.setTimeout(function () {
            form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.submit();
        }, 250);
    });
})();
</script>

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Django's command-line utility for administrative tasks."""
import os
import sys


def main():
    """Run administrative tasks."""
    os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'possumus.settings')
    try:
        from django.core.management import execute_from_command_line
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise ImportError(
            "Couldn't import Django. Are you sure it's installed and "
            "available on your PYTHONPATH environment variable? Did you "
            "forget to activate a virtual environment?"
        ) from exc
    execute_from_command_line(sys.argv)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

from urllib import request
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Brand, Product,Sale,SaleItem, Customer, Supplier , Purchase, PurchaseItem, Category, LedgerEntry, CompanyProfile
from django.contrib.contenttypes.models import ContentType
# Register your models here.

@admin.register(Product)
class ProductAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "brand", "sku","barcode", "category", "supplier", "price", "stock","low_stock_threshold","location", "is_active")
    list_filter = ("brand", "supplier", "is_active")
    search_fields = ("name", "sku", "barcode")
    
@admin.register(Sale)
class SaleAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("id", "customer", "created_at", "total_amount")
    
@admin.register(SaleItem)
class SaleItemAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("sale", "product", "quantity", "price")
    def get_actions(self, request):
        actions = super().get_actions(request)
        if "delete_selected" in actions:
            del actions["delete_selected"]
        return actions
    
    
@admin.register(Customer)
class CustomerAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "phone", "email", "is_active")
    search_fields = ("name", "phone")
    list_filter = ("is_active",)
    
@admin.register(Supplier)
class SupplierAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "phone", "email", "address","is_active")
    search_fields = ("name", "phone")
    list_filter = ("is_active",)
    
@admin.register(Purchase)
class PurchaseAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("id", "supplier", "created_at", "total_amount")
    list_filter = ("supplier",)
    
@admin.register(PurchaseItem)
class PurchaseItemAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("purchase", "product", "quantity", "cost_price")
    def get_actions(self, request):
        actions = super().get_actions(request)
        if "delete_selected" in actions:
            del actions["delete_selected"]
        return actions


@admin.register(Category)
class CategoryAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ("name", "is_active")
    


@admin.register(LedgerEntry)
class LedgerEntryAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = (
        'party_name',
        'party_type',
        'entry_type',
        'amount',
        'reference',
        'created_at',
    )

    list_filter = (
        'entry_type',
        'reference',
        'content_type',
        'created_at',
    )

    search_fields = (
        'note',
        'reference',
        'object_id',
    )

    date_hierarchy = 'created_at'

    ordering = ('-created_at',)

    readonly_fields = ('created_at',)

    fieldsets = (
        ("Party", {
            "fields": ("content_type", "object_id")
        }),
        ("Transaction", {
            "fields": ("entry_type", "amount", "reference", "note")
        }),
        ("Meta", {
            "fields": ("created_at",)
        }),
    )

    party_type.short_description = "Type"

from pos.services.access import get_user_role_label, is_admin, is_cashier


def app_shell(request):
    active_session = None
    active_company = None
    system_settings = None

    from pos.models import CompanyProfile, SystemSettings

    active_company = CompanyProfile.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
    system_settings = SystemSettings.load()

    if getattr(request, "user", None) and request.user.is_authenticated:
        from pos.models import UserSessionLog

        log_id = request.session.get("user_session_log_id")
        if log_id:
            active_session = (
                UserSessionLog.objects.filter(id=log_id, user=request.user, logout_at__isnull=True)
                .only("login_at")
                .first()
            )

    return {
        "is_admin_user": is_admin(getattr(request, "user", None)),
        "is_cashier_user": is_cashier(getattr(request, "user", None)),
        "user_role_label": get_user_role_label(getattr(request, "user", None)),
        "active_user_session": active_session,
        "active_company": active_company,
        "system_settings": system_settings,
    }

    (ADMIN_ROLE, "Admin"),
    (CASHIER_ROLE, "Cashier"),

class StyledFieldsMixin:
    def _apply_bootstrap(self):
        for field in self.fields.values():
            widget = field.widget
            if isinstance(widget, forms.CheckboxInput):
                widget.attrs.setdefault("class", "form-check-input")
            elif isinstance(widget, forms.Select):
                widget.attrs.setdefault("class", "form-select")
            elif isinstance(widget, forms.Textarea):
                css = widget.attrs.get("class", "")
                widget.attrs["class"] = (css + " form-control").strip()
                widget.attrs.setdefault("rows", 3)
            else:
                css = widget.attrs.get("class", "")
                widget.attrs["class"] = (css + " form-control").strip()


class StyledModelForm(StyledFieldsMixin, forms.ModelForm):
    pass


class LoginForm(StyledFieldsMixin, AuthenticationForm):
    username = forms.CharField(label="Login ID")

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self._apply_bootstrap()
        self.fields["username"].widget.attrs.setdefault("autofocus", True)
        self.fields["username"].widget.attrs.setdefault("placeholder", "Enter login ID")
        self.fields["password"].widget.attrs.setdefault("placeholder", "Enter password")


class FirstAdminSetupForm(StyledFieldsMixin, UserCreationForm):
    first_name = forms.CharField(max_length=150, required=False)
    last_name = forms.CharField(max_length=150, required=False)
    email = forms.EmailField(required=False)

    class Meta(UserCreationForm.Meta):
        model = get_user_model()
        fields = ["username", "first_name", "last_name", "email"]

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self._apply_bootstrap()
        self.fields["username"].label = "Admin Login ID"
        self.fields["username"].help_text = "Use this ID to sign in as the business owner or administrator."

    def save(self, commit=True):
        user = super().save(commit=False)
        user.first_name = self.cleaned_data.get("first_name", "")
        user.last_name = self.cleaned_data.get("last_name", "")
        user.email = self.cleaned_data.get("email", "")
        user.is_staff = True
        user.is_active = True
        if commit:
            user.save()
        return user

class PurchaseForm(StyledModelForm):
    class Meta:
        model = Purchase
        fields = ["supplier", "payment_method", "bank_account", "paid_amount"]
        labels = {
            "supplier": "Supplier",
            "payment_method": "Payment Method",
            "bank_account": "Bank Ledger",
            "paid_amount": "Paid Now",
        }
        help_texts = {
            "supplier": "Keep blank only for a pure cash purchase with no party tracking.",
            "bank_account": "Required only when the paid amount leaves a bank ledger.",
            "paid_amount": "Enter 0 for full credit. Enter the amount paid at the time of purchase.",
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self._apply_bootstrap()
        self.fields["supplier"].required = False
        self.fields["supplier"].queryset = Supplier.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by("name")
        self.fields["bank_account"].required = False
        self.fields["bank_account"].queryset = bank_account_queryset()

    def clean_paid_amount(self):
        paid_amount = self.cleaned_data["paid_amount"]
        if paid_amount < 0:
            raise forms.ValidationError("Paid amount cannot be negative.")
        return paid_amount

    def clean(self):
        cleaned_data = super().clean()
        if cleaned_data.get("payment_method") == Purchase.CASH:
            cleaned_data["bank_account"] = None
            self.instance.bank_account = None
        return cleaned_data

class BasePurchaseItemFormSet(BaseModelFormSet):
    def clean(self):
        super().clean()
        active_forms = 0
        for form in self.forms:
            if not getattr(form, "cleaned_data", None):
                continue
            if form.cleaned_data.get("DELETE"):
                continue
            if not form.cleaned_data.get("product"):
                continue
            active_forms += 1

        if active_forms == 0:
            raise forms.ValidationError("At least one purchase item is required.")


PurchaseItemFormSet = modelformset_factory(
    PurchaseItem,
    form=PurchaseItemForm,
    formset=BasePurchaseItemFormSet,
    extra=3,
    can_delete=True,
)





class StockAdjustmentForm(StyledFieldsMixin, forms.Form):
    REASON_CHOICES = (
        ("damaged", "Damaged / Expired"),
        ("lost", "Lost / Missing"),
        ("opening_balance", "Opening Balance Correction"),
        ("stock_take_difference", "Stock Take Difference"),
        ("other", "Other"),
    )

    product = forms.ModelChoiceField(queryset=Product.objects.none())
    adjustment_mode = forms.ChoiceField(choices=StockAdjustment.MODE_CHOICES)
    quantity_delta = forms.IntegerField(required=False, label="Adjustment Quantity")
    quantity_after = forms.IntegerField(required=False, min_value=0, label="Counted Stock")
    reason_preset = forms.ChoiceField(choices=REASON_CHOICES, label="Reason")
    custom_reason = forms.CharField(required=False, max_length=150, label="Custom Reason")
    reason = forms.CharField(max_length=150, widget=forms.HiddenInput())
    notes = forms.CharField(required=False, widget=forms.Textarea)

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self._apply_bootstrap()
        self.fields["reason"].widget = forms.HiddenInput()
        self.fields["product"].queryset = Product.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by("name")
        self.fields["adjustment_mode"].help_text = "Use Stock Take when you counted the shelf and want to set the final stock directly."
        self.fields["quantity_delta"].help_text = "Use positive numbers to add stock and negative numbers to remove stock."
        self.fields["quantity_after"].help_text = "Used only for stock take mode."
        self.fields["reason_preset"].help_text = "Pick the closest business reason so stock corrections stay consistent."
        self.fields["custom_reason"].help_text = "Use only when the preset list does not fit."
        self.fields["notes"].help_text = "Optional details like batch, shelf, staff note, or count reference."

        initial_reason = self.initial.get("reason") or getattr(self, "cleaned_data", {}).get("reason")
        if initial_reason:
            preset_values = {choice[0] for choice in self.REASON_CHOICES}
            if initial_reason in preset_values:
                self.fields["reason_preset"].initial = initial_reason
            else:
                self.fields["reason_preset"].initial = "other"
                self.fields["custom_reason"].initial = initial_reason

    def clean(self):
        cleaned_data = super().clean()
        mode = cleaned_data.get("adjustment_mode")
        reason_preset = cleaned_data.get("reason_preset")
        custom_reason = (cleaned_data.get("custom_reason") or "").strip()

        if mode == StockAdjustment.STOCK_TAKE:
            if cleaned_data.get("quantity_after") in (None, ""):
                self.add_error("quantity_after", "Enter the counted stock quantity.")
            cleaned_data["quantity_delta"] = None
            if reason_preset in (None, ""):
                cleaned_data["reason_preset"] = "stock_take_difference"
                reason_preset = "stock_take_difference"
        else:
            if cleaned_data.get("quantity_delta") in (None, ""):
                self.add_error("quantity_delta", "Enter the adjustment quantity.")
            cleaned_data["quantity_after"] = None

        if reason_preset == "other":
            if not custom_reason:
                self.add_error("custom_reason", "Enter the reason when Other is selected.")
            cleaned_data["reason"] = custom_reason
        else:
            reason_map = dict(self.REASON_CHOICES)
            cleaned_data["reason"] = reason_map.get(reason_preset, "")

        return cleaned_data




class SaleReturnForm(StyledFieldsMixin, forms.Form):
    refund_method = forms.ChoiceField(choices=SaleReturn.REFUND_METHOD_CHOICES)
    bank_account = forms.ModelChoiceField(queryset=bank_account_queryset(), required=False)
    reason = forms.CharField(max_length=150)
    notes = forms.CharField(required=False, widget=forms.Textarea)

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self._apply_bootstrap()
        self.fields["bank_account"].queryset = bank_account_queryset()
        self.fields["refund_method"].help_text = "Reduce receivable for credit sales, or refund from cash or a bank ledger."

    def clean(self):
        cleaned_data = super().clean()
        if cleaned_data.get("refund_method") != SaleReturn.BANK:
            cleaned_data["bank_account"] = None
        elif not cleaned_data.get("bank_account"):
            self.add_error("bank_account", "Choose which bank ledger the refund is leaving from.")
        return cleaned_data

from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP

from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.contenttypes.fields import GenericForeignKey
from django.contrib.contenttypes.models import ContentType
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone


TWO_PLACES = Decimal("0.01")


def quantize_money(value):
    return Decimal(value).quantize(TWO_PLACES, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


class Category(models.Model):
    TAXABLE = "taxable"
    ZERO_RATED = "zero_rated"
    EXEMPT = "exempt"
    TAX_STATUS_CHOICES = (
        (TAXABLE, "Taxable"),
        (ZERO_RATED, "Zero Rated"),
        (EXEMPT, "Exempt"),
    )

    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    tax_status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TAX_STATUS_CHOICES, default=EXEMPT)
    gst_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

    @property
    def effective_gst_rate(self):
        if self.tax_status == self.TAXABLE:
            return quantize_money(self.gst_rate or 0)
        return Decimal("0")

    def clean(self):
        errors = {}
        gst_rate = Decimal(self.gst_rate or 0)

        if gst_rate < 0:
            errors["gst_rate"] = "GST rate cannot be negative."
        if gst_rate > 100:
            errors["gst_rate"] = "GST rate cannot exceed 100%."

        if self.tax_status != self.TAXABLE:
            self.gst_rate = Decimal("0")

        if errors:
            raise ValidationError(errors)

class Brand(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name


class Supplier(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    phone = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)
    email = models.EmailField(blank=True)
    address = models.TextField(blank=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

    @property
    def raw_balance(self):
        from accounts.services.party_balance import get_party_balance

        return get_party_balance(self)


class Product(models.Model):
    category = models.ForeignKey(
        Category,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="products",
    )
    brand = models.ForeignKey(
        Brand,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="products",
    )
    supplier = models.ForeignKey(
        Supplier,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="products",
    )
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    sku = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True)
    barcode = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True, blank=True, null=True)
    cost_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, help_text="Selling price")
    minimum_margin_percent = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    stock = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    low_stock_threshold = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        default=5,
        help_text="Alert when stock falls to this level",
    )
    location = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

    def minimum_sale_price_for_cost(self, cost_price=None):
        cost = Decimal(cost_price if cost_price is not None else self.cost_price or 0)
        margin = Decimal(self.minimum_margin_percent or 0)
        multiplier = Decimal("1") + (margin / Decimal("100"))
        return quantize_money(cost * multiplier)

    @property
    def minimum_sale_price(self):
        return self.minimum_sale_price_for_cost()

    @property
    def current_margin_percent(self):
        cost = Decimal(self.cost_price or 0)
        if cost <= 0:
            return None
        price = Decimal(self.price or 0)
        margin = ((price - cost) / cost) * Decimal("100")
        return quantize_money(margin)

    @property
    def margin_status(self):
        margin = self.current_margin_percent
        if margin is None:
            return "unknown"
        if margin < Decimal(self.minimum_margin_percent or 0):
            return "below"
        return "healthy"

    def clean(self):
        errors = {}

        if Decimal(self.cost_price or 0) < 0:
            errors["cost_price"] = "Cost price cannot be negative."
        if Decimal(self.price or 0) < 0:
            errors["price"] = "Sale price cannot be negative."
        if Decimal(self.minimum_margin_percent or 0) < 0:
            errors["minimum_margin_percent"] = "Minimum margin cannot be negative."

        if Decimal(self.price or 0) and Decimal(self.cost_price or 0):
            minimum_sale_price = self.minimum_sale_price
            if Decimal(self.price) < minimum_sale_price:
                errors["price"] = (
                    f"Sale price must be at least {minimum_sale_price} to keep the minimum margin."
                )

        if errors:
            raise ValidationError(errors)
