class Sale(models.Model):
    CASH = "cash"
    BANK = "bank"
    TAX_MODE_MANUAL = "manual_cart"
    TAX_MODE_CATEGORY = "category_gst"
    PAYMENT_METHOD_CHOICES = (
        (CASH, "Cash"),
        (BANK, "Bank"),
    )
    TAX_MODE_CHOICES = (
        (TAX_MODE_MANUAL, "Manual Cart Tax"),
        (TAX_MODE_CATEGORY, "Category GST"),
    )

    customer = models.ForeignKey(
        Customer,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="sales",
    )
    sold_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="sales_made",
    )
    is_credit = models.BooleanField(default=False, help_text="Sale on credit")
    payment_method = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=PAYMENT_METHOD_CHOICES, default=CASH)
    bank_account = models.ForeignKey("accounts.BankAccount", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="sales")
    paid_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    discount_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    tax_rate = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    tax_mode = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TAX_MODE_CHOICES, default=TAX_MODE_MANUAL)
    tax_label = models.CharField(max_length=30, default="GST")
    tax_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"Sale #{self.id}"

    def clean(self):
        errors = {}
        paid_amount = Decimal(self.paid_amount or 0)

        if paid_amount < 0:
            errors["paid_amount"] = "Paid amount cannot be negative."
        if self.is_credit or paid_amount == 0 or self.payment_method == self.CASH:
            self.bank_account = None

        if errors:
            raise ValidationError(errors)


    def safe_decimal(self, value):
        try:
            return Decimal(value)
        except (TypeError, InvalidOperation):
            return Decimal("0")

    @property
    def subtotal(self):
        return sum((item.line_total for item in self.items.all()), Decimal("0"))

    @property
    def balance_due(self):
        return quantize_money(max(Decimal(self.total_amount or 0) - Decimal(self.paid_amount or 0), Decimal("0")))

    @property
    def net_sales_amount(self):
        return quantize_money(Decimal(self.total_amount or 0) - Decimal(self.tax_amount or 0))

    def _category_tax_amount(self, items, discount_amount):
        subtotal = sum((item.line_total for item in items), Decimal("0"))
        if subtotal <= 0:
            return Decimal("0")

        remaining_discount = quantize_money(discount_amount)
        total_tax = Decimal("0")

        for index, item in enumerate(items):
            if index == len(items) - 1:
                allocated_discount = remaining_discount
            else:
                share = Decimal(item.line_total) / subtotal
                allocated_discount = quantize_money(Decimal(discount_amount) * share)
                remaining_discount -= allocated_discount

            taxable_base = max(Decimal(item.line_total) - Decimal(allocated_discount), Decimal("0"))
            category = getattr(item.product, "category", None)
            tax_rate = Decimal(category.effective_gst_rate if category else 0)
            total_tax += quantize_money(taxable_base * (tax_rate / Decimal("100")))

        return quantize_money(total_tax)

    def update_total(self):
        items = list(self.items.select_related("product__category"))
        subtotal = sum((item.line_total for item in items), Decimal("0"))

        discount_rate = min(max(self.safe_decimal(self.discount_rate), Decimal("0")), Decimal("100"))
        tax_rate = min(max(self.safe_decimal(self.tax_rate), Decimal("0")), Decimal("100"))

        discount_amount = subtotal * (discount_rate / Decimal("100"))
        after_discount = subtotal - discount_amount
        if self.tax_mode == self.TAX_MODE_CATEGORY:
            tax_amount = self._category_tax_amount(items, discount_amount)
            self.tax_rate = Decimal("0")
        else:
            tax_amount = after_discount * (tax_rate / Decimal("100"))

        self.tax_amount = quantize_money(tax_amount)
        self.total_amount = quantize_money(after_discount + tax_amount)
        self.save(update_fields=["tax_rate", "tax_amount", "total_amount"])


class SaleItem(models.Model):
    sale = models.ForeignKey(Sale, related_name="items", on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    product = models.ForeignKey(Product, on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    quantity = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    original_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    discount_percent = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    cost_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)

    @property
    def discounted_unit_price(self):
        discount = Decimal(self.discount_percent or 0)
        multiplier = Decimal("1") - (discount / Decimal("100"))
        return quantize_money(Decimal(self.price) * multiplier)

    @property
    def base_line_total(self):
        return quantize_money(Decimal(self.price) * Decimal(self.quantity))

    @property
    def line_total(self):
        return quantize_money(self.discounted_unit_price * Decimal(self.quantity))

    @property
    def line_discount_amount(self):
        return quantize_money(self.base_line_total - self.line_total)

    @property
    def line_cost(self):
        return quantize_money(Decimal(self.cost_price) * Decimal(self.quantity))

    def clean(self):
        errors = {}
        if self.quantity <= 0:
            errors["quantity"] = "Quantity must be greater than zero."
        if Decimal(self.price or 0) <= 0:
            errors["price"] = "Price must be greater than zero."
        if Decimal(self.original_price or 0) < 0:
            errors["original_price"] = "Original price cannot be negative."
        if Decimal(self.cost_price or 0) < 0:
            errors["cost_price"] = "Cost price cannot be negative."

        discount_percent = Decimal(self.discount_percent or 0)
        if discount_percent < 0 or discount_percent > 100:
            errors["discount_percent"] = "Discount percent must be between 0 and 100."

        minimum_price = self.product.minimum_sale_price_for_cost(self.cost_price or self.product.cost_price)
        if self.discounted_unit_price < minimum_price:
            errors["price"] = f"Final unit price cannot go below {minimum_price}."

        available_stock = self.product.stock
        if self.pk:
            old_item = SaleItem.objects.select_related("product").get(pk=self.pk)
            if old_item.product_id == self.product_id:
                available_stock += old_item.quantity
        if self.quantity > available_stock:
            errors["quantity"] = f"Not enough stock for {self.product.name}."

        if errors:
            raise ValidationError(errors)

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        is_new = self.pk is None
        if is_new and not self.original_price:
            self.original_price = self.product.price
        if is_new and not self.price:
            self.price = self.product.price
        if is_new and self.discount_percent in (None, ""):
            self.discount_percent = Decimal("0")
        if is_new and not self.cost_price:
            self.cost_price = self.product.cost_price

        self.clean()

        if is_new:
            self.product.stock -= self.quantity
            self.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])
        else:
            old_item = SaleItem.objects.select_related("product").get(pk=self.pk)
            if old_item.product_id == self.product_id:
                self.product.stock = self.product.stock + old_item.quantity - self.quantity
                self.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])
            else:
                old_product = old_item.product
                old_product.stock += old_item.quantity
                old_product.save(update_fields=["stock"])

                self.product.stock -= self.quantity
                self.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])

        super().save(*args, **kwargs)
        self.sale.update_total()

    def delete(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.product.stock += self.quantity
        self.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])

        sale = self.sale
        super().delete(*args, **kwargs)
        sale.update_total()

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.product.name} x {self.quantity}"

class Purchase(models.Model):
    CASH = "cash"
    BANK = "bank"
    PAYMENT_METHOD_CHOICES = (
        (CASH, "Cash"),
        (BANK, "Bank"),
    )

    supplier = models.ForeignKey(
        Supplier,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="purchases",
    )
    payment_method = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=PAYMENT_METHOD_CHOICES, default=CASH)
    bank_account = models.ForeignKey("accounts.BankAccount", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="purchases")
    paid_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    total_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    last_edited_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        related_name="edited_purchases",
    )
    last_edited_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    edit_reason = models.TextField(blank=True)
    def clean(self):
        errors = {}
        if Decimal(self.paid_amount or 0) < 0:
            errors["paid_amount"] = "Paid amount cannot be negative."
        if self.payment_method == self.CASH or Decimal(self.paid_amount or 0) == 0:
            self.bank_account = None
        if errors:
            raise ValidationError(errors)

        if errors:
            raise ValidationError(errors)

    @property
    def balance_due(self):
        return quantize_money(max(Decimal(self.total_amount or 0) - Decimal(self.paid_amount or 0), Decimal("0")))

    @property
    def payment_status(self):
        if self.total_amount <= 0:
            return "draft"
        if self.balance_due <= 0:
            return "paid"
        if Decimal(self.paid_amount or 0) > 0:
            return "partial"
        return "credit"

    def update_total(self):
        total = Decimal("0")
        for item in self.items.all():
            total += item.line_total

        self.total_amount = quantize_money(total)
        self.save(update_fields=["total_amount"])


class PurchaseItem(models.Model):
    purchase = models.ForeignKey(Purchase, related_name="items", on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    product = models.ForeignKey(Product, on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    quantity = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    cost_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    sale_price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True)

    @property
    def line_total(self):
        return quantize_money(Decimal(self.cost_price) * Decimal(self.quantity))

    @property
    def margin_percent(self):
        cost = Decimal(self.cost_price or 0)
        if cost <= 0:
            return None
        return quantize_money(((Decimal(self.sale_price or 0) - cost) / cost) * Decimal("100"))

    @property
    def total_price(self):
        return self.line_total

    def clean(self):
        if not self.product_id and not self.quantity and not self.cost_price and not self.sale_price:
            return

        errors = {}
        if not self.product_id:
            errors["product"] = "Product is required."
        if self.quantity in (None, "") or self.quantity <= 0:
            errors["quantity"] = "Quantity must be greater than zero."
        if self.cost_price in (None, "") or Decimal(self.cost_price or 0) <= 0:
            errors["cost_price"] = "Cost price must be greater than zero."
        if self.sale_price in (None, "") or Decimal(self.sale_price or 0) <= 0:
            errors["sale_price"] = "Sale price must be greater than zero."

        if self.product_id and self.cost_price not in (None, "") and self.sale_price not in (None, ""):
            minimum_sale_price = self.product.minimum_sale_price_for_cost(self.cost_price)
            if Decimal(self.sale_price or 0) < minimum_sale_price:
                errors["sale_price"] = (
                    f"Sale price must be at least {minimum_sale_price} for the configured minimum margin."
                )

        if errors:
            raise ValidationError(errors)

    def _sync_product_pricing(self):
        updated_fields = []
        if self.purchase.supplier_id and self.product.supplier_id != self.purchase.supplier_id:
            self.product.supplier = self.purchase.supplier
            updated_fields.append("supplier")
        if Decimal(self.product.cost_price or 0) != Decimal(self.cost_price or 0):
            self.product.cost_price = self.cost_price
            updated_fields.append("cost_price")
        if Decimal(self.product.price or 0) != Decimal(self.sale_price or 0):
            self.product.price = self.sale_price
            updated_fields.append("price")

        if updated_fields:
            self.product.save(update_fields=updated_fields)

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.clean()
        is_new = self.pk is None

        if is_new:
            self.product.stock += self.quantity
            self.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])
            old_total = Decimal("0")
        else:
            old_item = PurchaseItem.objects.select_related("product").get(pk=self.pk)
            old_total = self.purchase.total_amount

            if old_item.product_id == self.product_id:
                new_stock = self.product.stock + (self.quantity - old_item.quantity)
                if new_stock < 0:
                    raise ValidationError("Cannot reduce stock below zero")
                self.product.stock = new_stock
                self.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])
            else:
                old_product = old_item.product
                restored_old_stock = old_product.stock - old_item.quantity
                if restored_old_stock < 0:
                    raise ValidationError(
                        "Cannot change this purchase item because existing stock has already been consumed"
                    )
                old_product.stock = restored_old_stock
                old_product.save(update_fields=["stock"])

                self.product.stock += self.quantity
                self.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])

        super().save(*args, **kwargs)
        self._sync_product_pricing()
        self.purchase.update_total()

    def delete(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.product.stock < self.quantity:
            raise ValidationError("Cannot reduce stock below zero")

        self.product.stock -= self.quantity
        self.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])

        purchase = self.purchase
        super().delete(*args, **kwargs)
        purchase.update_total()

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.product.name} x {self.quantity}"

        default=Sale.CASH,

        verbose_name = "System Settings"

    def uses_category_gst(self):

        self.tax_label = (self.tax_label or "GST").strip() or "GST"
        self.thermal_printer_width_mm = max(int(self.thermal_printer_width_mm or 50), 50)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

from functools import wraps

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group
from django.contrib.auth.views import redirect_to_login
from django.shortcuts import redirect
from django.urls import reverse
from django.utils import timezone


ADMIN_ROLE = "admin"
CASHIER_ROLE = "cashier"
ROLE_GROUPS = {
    ADMIN_ROLE: "Admin",
    CASHIER_ROLE: "Cashier",
}


def ensure_role_groups():
    groups = {}
    for role, name in ROLE_GROUPS.items():
        groups[role], _ = Group.objects.get_or_create(name=name)
    return groups


def is_first_user_setup_required():
    return not get_user_model().objects.exists()


def is_admin(user):
    if not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return False
    if user.is_superuser or user.is_staff:
        return True
    return user.groups.filter(name=ROLE_GROUPS[ADMIN_ROLE]).exists()


def is_cashier(user):
    if not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return False
    return user.groups.filter(name=ROLE_GROUPS[CASHIER_ROLE]).exists()


def get_user_role_label(user):
    if is_admin(user):
        return "Admin"
    if is_cashier(user):
        return "Cashier"
    return "Unassigned"


def default_home_url(user):
    if is_cashier(user):
        return reverse("pos_screen")
    return reverse("dashboard")


def assign_role(user, role):
    groups = ensure_role_groups()
    user.groups.remove(*groups.values())

    selected_group = groups.get(role)
    if selected_group:
        user.groups.add(selected_group)

    update_fields = []
    if role == ADMIN_ROLE:
        user.is_staff = True
        update_fields.append("is_staff")
    elif role == CASHIER_ROLE:
        user.is_staff = False
        user.is_superuser = False
        update_fields.extend(["is_staff", "is_superuser"])

    if update_fields:
        user.save(update_fields=update_fields)
    return user


def _client_ip(request):
    forwarded = (request.META.get("HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR") or "").strip()
    if forwarded:
        return forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
    return (request.META.get("REMOTE_ADDR") or "").strip() or None


def open_user_session(request, user):
    from pos.models import UserSessionLog

    if not request.session.session_key:
        request.session.save()

    session_key = request.session.session_key
    UserSessionLog.objects.filter(session_key=session_key, logout_at__isnull=True).update(logout_at=timezone.now())
    log = UserSessionLog.objects.create(
        user=user,
        role_name=get_user_role_label(user),
        session_key=session_key,
        ip_address=_client_ip(request),
    )
    request.session["user_session_log_id"] = log.id
    request.session.modified = True
    return log


def close_user_session(request):
    from pos.models import UserSessionLog

    log_id = request.session.get("user_session_log_id")
    if not log_id:
        return

    UserSessionLog.objects.filter(id=log_id, logout_at__isnull=True).update(logout_at=timezone.now())
    request.session.pop("user_session_log_id", None)
    request.session.modified = True


def user_can_access_sale(user, sale):
    return is_admin(user) or (is_cashier(user) and sale.sold_by_id == getattr(user, "id", None))


def role_required(*allowed_roles):
    normalized_roles = {role.lower() for role in allowed_roles}

    def decorator(view_func):
        @wraps(view_func)
        def wrapped(request, *args, **kwargs):
            if is_first_user_setup_required():
                return redirect("setup_admin")

            if not request.user.is_authenticated:
                return redirect_to_login(request.get_full_path(), reverse("login"))

            if is_admin(request.user):
                return view_func(request, *args, **kwargs)

            if CASHIER_ROLE in normalized_roles and is_cashier(request.user):
                return view_func(request, *args, **kwargs)

            if is_cashier(request.user):
                messages.error(request, "Cashier accounts can only access POS and their own receipts.")
                return redirect(default_home_url(request.user))

            messages.error(request, "Your account does not have access to this area.")
            return redirect("login")

        return wrapped

    return decorator


admin_required = role_required(ADMIN_ROLE)
pos_access_required = role_required(ADMIN_ROLE, CASHIER_ROLE)

from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation

from pos.models import CompanyProfile, Sale, SystemSettings, quantize_money


def safe_decimal(value):
    try:
        return Decimal(value)
    except (TypeError, InvalidOperation):
        return Decimal("0")


def normalized_rate(value):
    rate = safe_decimal(value)
    if rate < 0:
        return Decimal("0")
    if rate > 100:
        return Decimal("100")
    return quantize_money(rate)


def get_active_company_profile(create=False):
    company = CompanyProfile.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
    if company or not create:
        return company
    return CompanyProfile.objects.create(
        name="POS IMS",
        invoice_footer="Thank you for your business.",
        is_active=True,
    )


def get_system_settings():
    return SystemSettings.load()


def category_tax_rate_for_product(product):
    category = getattr(product, "category", None)
    if not category:
        return Decimal("0")
    return Decimal(category.effective_gst_rate or 0)


def sale_discount_amount(subtotal, discount_rate):
    subtotal = safe_decimal(subtotal)
    return quantize_money(subtotal * (normalized_rate(discount_rate) / Decimal("100")))


def sale_tax_label(sale, fallback="GST"):
    return (getattr(sale, "tax_label", "") or fallback or "GST").strip() or "GST"


def sale_tax_amount(sale, subtotal=None, items=None):
    stored_tax = quantize_money(getattr(sale, "tax_amount", 0) or 0)
    manual_tax_rate = normalized_rate(getattr(sale, "tax_rate", 0) or 0)

    if stored_tax > 0 or manual_tax_rate <= 0:
        return stored_tax

    if subtotal is None:
        if items is None:
            items = sale.items.all()
        subtotal = sum((item.line_total for item in items), Decimal("0"))

    discount_amount = sale_discount_amount(subtotal, getattr(sale, "discount_rate", 0) or 0)
    after_discount = Decimal(subtotal) - Decimal(discount_amount)
    return quantize_money(after_discount * (manual_tax_rate / Decimal("100")))


def category_tax_from_rows(rows, discount_amount):
    subtotal = sum((Decimal(row["line_total"]) for row in rows), Decimal("0"))
    if subtotal <= 0:
        return Decimal("0")

    remaining_discount = quantize_money(discount_amount)
    total_tax = Decimal("0")

    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        line_total = Decimal(row["line_total"])
        if index == len(rows) - 1:
            allocated_discount = remaining_discount
        else:
            share = line_total / subtotal
            allocated_discount = quantize_money(Decimal(discount_amount) * share)
            remaining_discount -= allocated_discount

        taxable_base = max(line_total - Decimal(allocated_discount), Decimal("0"))
        tax_rate = normalized_rate(row.get("category_tax_rate", 0))
        total_tax += quantize_money(taxable_base * (tax_rate / Decimal("100")))

    return quantize_money(total_tax)


def sale_totals_from_rows(rows, discount_rate, manual_tax_rate, settings_obj):
    subtotal = sum((Decimal(row["line_total"]) for row in rows), Decimal("0"))
    line_discount_total = sum((Decimal(row.get("line_discount_amount", 0)) for row in rows), Decimal("0"))
    discount_amount = sale_discount_amount(subtotal, discount_rate)
    after_discount = quantize_money(subtotal - discount_amount)

    if settings_obj.uses_category_gst:
        applied_tax_rate = Decimal("0")
        tax_amount = category_tax_from_rows(rows, discount_amount)
    elif settings_obj.allows_manual_tax:
        applied_tax_rate = normalized_rate(manual_tax_rate)
        tax_amount = quantize_money(after_discount * (applied_tax_rate / Decimal("100")))
    else:
        applied_tax_rate = Decimal("0")
        tax_amount = Decimal("0")

    total_amount = quantize_money(after_discount + tax_amount)
    return {
        "subtotal": quantize_money(subtotal),
        "line_discount_total": quantize_money(line_discount_total),
        "discount_amount": quantize_money(discount_amount),
        "net_sales": quantize_money(after_discount),
        "tax_amount": quantize_money(tax_amount),
        "total_amount": total_amount,
        "applied_tax_rate": applied_tax_rate,
    }

FILE: pos/services/cart_pricing.py

from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

from pos.models import quantize_money


ZERO = Decimal("0")
HUNDRED = Decimal("100")


def seed_cart_item(product):
    return {
        "name": product.name,
        "price": str(quantize_money(product.price)),
        "original_price": str(quantize_money(product.price)),
        "discount_percent": "0.00",
        "quantity": 1,
    }



def to_decimal(value, default=ZERO):
    try:
        if value in (None, ""):
            return default
        return Decimal(value)
    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError):
        return default



def clamp_discount_percent(value):
    discount = to_decimal(value)
    if discount < ZERO:
        discount = ZERO
    if discount > HUNDRED:
        discount = HUNDRED
    return quantize_money(discount)



def effective_unit_price(unit_price, discount_percent):
    unit = quantize_money(to_decimal(unit_price))
    discount = clamp_discount_percent(discount_percent)
    multiplier = Decimal("1") - (discount / HUNDRED)
    return quantize_money(unit * multiplier)



def line_total(quantity, unit_price, discount_percent):
    return quantize_money(effective_unit_price(unit_price, discount_percent) * to_decimal(quantity))



def validate_cart_line(product, unit_price, discount_percent):
    unit = quantize_money(to_decimal(unit_price))
    discount = clamp_discount_percent(discount_percent)

    if unit <= ZERO:
        raise ValidationError("Custom price must be greater than zero.")

    minimum_price = product.minimum_sale_price_for_cost(product.cost_price)
    final_unit_price = effective_unit_price(unit, discount)
    if final_unit_price < minimum_price:
        raise ValidationError(
            f"Final unit price cannot go below Rs {minimum_price:.2f}."
        )

    return {
        "price": unit,
        "discount_percent": discount,
        "final_unit_price": final_unit_price,
        "minimum_price": minimum_price,
    }



def normalize_cart_item(item):
    quantity = int(item.get("quantity", 0) or 0)
    price = quantize_money(to_decimal(item.get("price")))
    original_price = quantize_money(to_decimal(item.get("original_price"), price))
    discount_percent = clamp_discount_percent(item.get("discount_percent", 0))

    return {
        **item,
        "quantity": quantity,
        "price": str(price),
        "original_price": str(original_price),
        "discount_percent": str(discount_percent),
    }

from urllib.parse import urlencode

from django.urls import reverse
from django.utils.http import url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme

POS_SELECTED_CUSTOMER_KEY = "pos_selected_customer_id"
POS_PREFILL_CREDIT_KEY = "pos_prefill_credit"


def get_safe_next_url(request, default_name):
    next_url = request.POST.get("next") or request.GET.get("next")
    if next_url and url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme(
        next_url,
        allowed_hosts={request.get_host()},
        require_https=request.is_secure(),
    ):
        return next_url
    return reverse(default_name)


def remember_customer_for_pos(request, customer_id, *, credit=False):
    request.session[POS_SELECTED_CUSTOMER_KEY] = customer_id
    request.session[POS_PREFILL_CREDIT_KEY] = credit


def pop_customer_for_pos(request):
    return (
        request.session.pop(POS_SELECTED_CUSTOMER_KEY, None),
        bool(request.session.pop(POS_PREFILL_CREDIT_KEY, False)),
    )


def build_customer_add_url():
    next_url = f"{reverse('pos_screen')}?credit=1"
    return f"{reverse('customer_add')}?{urlencode({'next': next_url})}"


def build_supplier_add_url(return_name='purchase_add'):
    next_url = reverse(return_name)
    return f"{reverse('supplier_add')}?{urlencode({'next': next_url})}"

from collections import defaultdict, deque
from decimal import Decimal

from django.contrib.contenttypes.models import ContentType

from accounts.models import Settlement
from pos.models import Purchase, Supplier, quantize_money


ZERO = Decimal("0.00")


def _money(value):
    return quantize_money(Decimal(value or 0))


def _payment_status(total, paid, due):
    if total <= 0:
        return "draft"
    if due <= 0:
        return "paid"
    if paid > 0:
        return "partial"
    return "credit"


def annotate_purchase_balances(purchases):
    rows = list(purchases)
    if not rows:
        return rows

    supplier_ids = sorted({purchase.supplier_id for purchase in rows if purchase.supplier_id})
    state_by_purchase = {}

    for purchase in rows:
        total = _money(purchase.total_amount)
        initial_paid = min(_money(purchase.paid_amount), total)
        due = quantize_money(max(total - initial_paid, ZERO))
        purchase.report_initial_paid = initial_paid
        purchase.report_settlement_paid = ZERO
        purchase.report_paid_amount = initial_paid
        purchase.report_balance_due = due
        purchase.report_payment_status = _payment_status(total, initial_paid, due)

    if not supplier_ids:
        return rows

    all_purchases = list(
        Purchase.objects.filter(supplier_id__in=supplier_ids)
        .only("id", "supplier_id", "total_amount", "paid_amount", "created_at")
        .order_by("created_at", "id")
    )
    supplier_type = ContentType.objects.get_for_model(Supplier)
    settlements = list(
        Settlement.objects.filter(
            settlement_type=Settlement.PAYMENT,
            content_type=supplier_type,
            object_id__in=supplier_ids,
        )
        .only("id", "object_id", "amount", "created_at")
        .order_by("created_at", "id")
    )

    purchases_by_supplier = defaultdict(list)
    settlements_by_supplier = defaultdict(list)

    for purchase in all_purchases:
        total = _money(purchase.total_amount)
        initial_paid = min(_money(purchase.paid_amount), total)
        state_by_purchase[purchase.id] = {
            "total": total,
            "initial_paid": initial_paid,
            "settlement_paid": ZERO,
            "due": quantize_money(max(total - initial_paid, ZERO)),
        }
        purchases_by_supplier[purchase.supplier_id].append(purchase)

    for settlement in settlements:
        settlements_by_supplier[settlement.object_id].append(settlement)

    for supplier_id in supplier_ids:
        open_purchases = deque()
        advance_pool = ZERO
        supplier_purchases = purchases_by_supplier[supplier_id]
        supplier_settlements = settlements_by_supplier[supplier_id]
        purchase_index = 0
        settlement_index = 0

        while purchase_index < len(supplier_purchases) or settlement_index < len(supplier_settlements):
            next_purchase = supplier_purchases[purchase_index] if purchase_index < len(supplier_purchases) else None
            next_settlement = supplier_settlements[settlement_index] if settlement_index < len(supplier_settlements) else None

            process_purchase = next_purchase is not None and (
                next_settlement is None or next_purchase.created_at <= next_settlement.created_at
            )

            if process_purchase:
                state = state_by_purchase[next_purchase.id]
                if advance_pool > ZERO and state["due"] > ZERO:
                    allocated = min(advance_pool, state["due"])
                    state["settlement_paid"] = quantize_money(state["settlement_paid"] + allocated)
                    state["due"] = quantize_money(state["due"] - allocated)
                    advance_pool = quantize_money(advance_pool - allocated)

                if state["due"] > ZERO:
                    open_purchases.append(next_purchase.id)
                purchase_index += 1
                continue

            remaining = _money(next_settlement.amount)
            while remaining > ZERO and open_purchases:
                purchase_id = open_purchases[0]
                state = state_by_purchase[purchase_id]
                allocated = min(remaining, state["due"])
                state["settlement_paid"] = quantize_money(state["settlement_paid"] + allocated)
                state["due"] = quantize_money(state["due"] - allocated)
                remaining = quantize_money(remaining - allocated)
                if state["due"] <= ZERO:
                    open_purchases.popleft()

            if remaining > ZERO:
                advance_pool = quantize_money(advance_pool + remaining)
            settlement_index += 1

    for purchase in rows:
        state = state_by_purchase.get(purchase.id)
        if state is None:
            continue
        purchase.report_initial_paid = state["initial_paid"]
        purchase.report_settlement_paid = state["settlement_paid"]
        purchase.report_paid_amount = quantize_money(state["initial_paid"] + state["settlement_paid"])
        purchase.report_balance_due = state["due"]
        purchase.report_payment_status = _payment_status(
            state["total"],
            purchase.report_paid_amount,
            purchase.report_balance_due,
        )

    return rows

from decimal import Decimal

from django.contrib.contenttypes.models import ContentType
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Sum
from django.utils import timezone

from accounts.models import Account, PartyLedgerEntry, Voucher, VoucherLine
from accounts.services.audit import record_audit
from accounts.services.cash_bank import resolve_money_account
from pos.models import (
    Purchase,
    PurchaseItem,
    PurchaseReturn,
    PurchaseReturnItem,
    Sale,
    SaleItem,
    SaleReturn,
    SaleReturnItem,
    quantize_money,
)


ZERO = Decimal("0.00")


def _ensure_account(title: str, account_type: str) -> Account:
    account, _ = Account.objects.get_or_create(title=title, defaults={"type": account_type})
    if account.type != account_type:
        raise ValueError(f"Account '{title}' exists with the wrong type.")
    if not account.is_active:
        account.is_active = True
        account.save(update_fields=["is_active"])
    return account


def _sale_item_returnable(item: SaleItem) -> int:
    returned = item.return_items.aggregate(total=Sum("quantity"))["total"] or 0
    return max(item.quantity - returned, 0)


def _purchase_item_returnable(item: PurchaseItem) -> int:
    returned = item.return_items.aggregate(total=Sum("quantity"))["total"] or 0
    return max(item.quantity - returned, 0)


@transaction.atomic
def create_sale_return(*, sale, quantities, refund_method, reason, notes="", bank_account=None, actor=None):
    sale_obj = (
        Sale.objects.select_related("customer")
        .prefetch_related("items__product__category", "items__return_items")
        .select_for_update()
        .get(pk=getattr(sale, "pk", sale))
    )

    if not (reason or "").strip():
        raise ValueError("Reason is required for sale return.")
    if refund_method == SaleReturn.RECEIVABLE and sale_obj.customer is None:
        raise ValueError("A customer is required to reduce receivable.")

    sale_return = SaleReturn.objects.create(
        sale=sale_obj,
        customer=sale_obj.customer,
        refund_method=refund_method,
        bank_account=bank_account,
        reason=reason.strip(),
        notes=notes,
        created_by=actor,
    )

    discount_factor = Decimal("1") - (Decimal(sale_obj.discount_rate or 0) / Decimal("100"))
    total_net = ZERO
    total_tax = ZERO
    total_cost = ZERO

    items_map = {item.id: item for item in sale_obj.items.all()}
    for item_id, qty in quantities.items():
        quantity = int(qty or 0)
        if quantity <= 0:
            continue
        item = items_map.get(int(item_id))
        if item is None:
            raise ValueError("One of the sale items could not be found.")
        returnable = _sale_item_returnable(item)
        if quantity > returnable:
            raise ValueError(f"Only {returnable} units of {item.product.name} can be returned.")

        line_amount = quantize_money(item.line_total * Decimal(quantity) / Decimal(item.quantity))
        net_amount = quantize_money(line_amount * discount_factor)
        if sale_obj.tax_mode == Sale.TAX_MODE_MANUAL:
            tax_amount = quantize_money(net_amount * (Decimal(sale_obj.tax_rate or 0) / Decimal("100")))
        else:
            rate = Decimal(item.product.category.effective_gst_rate if item.product.category else 0)
            tax_amount = quantize_money(net_amount * (rate / Decimal("100")))
        cost_amount = quantize_money(Decimal(item.cost_price or 0) * Decimal(quantity))

        SaleReturnItem.objects.create(
            sale_return=sale_return,
            sale_item=item,
            product=item.product,
            quantity=quantity,
            unit_price=item.discounted_unit_price,
            line_amount=line_amount,
            net_amount=net_amount,
            tax_amount=tax_amount,
            cost_amount=cost_amount,
        )

        item.product.stock += quantity
        item.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])

        total_net += net_amount
        total_tax += tax_amount
        total_cost += cost_amount

    if not sale_return.items.exists():
        raise ValueError("Select at least one return quantity.")

    total_amount = quantize_money(total_net + total_tax)
    sale_return.net_amount = quantize_money(total_net)
    sale_return.tax_amount = quantize_money(total_tax)
    sale_return.total_amount = total_amount
    sale_return.cost_amount = quantize_money(total_cost)

    voucher = Voucher.objects.create(
        voucher_type=Voucher.JOURNAL,
        date=timezone.localdate(),
        narration=f"Sale return #{sale_return.id} for sale #{sale_obj.id}",
        ref_model="SaleReturn",
        ref_id=sale_return.id,
    )
    VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=_ensure_account("Sales Returns", Account.INCOME), debit=sale_return.net_amount)
    if sale_return.tax_amount > ZERO:
        VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=_ensure_account("Sales Tax Payable", Account.LIABILITY), debit=sale_return.tax_amount)

    if refund_method == SaleReturn.RECEIVABLE:
        VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=_ensure_account("Accounts Receivable", Account.ASSET), credit=total_amount)
        PartyLedgerEntry.objects.create(
            voucher=voucher,
            content_type=ContentType.objects.get_for_model(sale_obj.customer),
            object_id=sale_obj.customer.id,
            credit=total_amount,
        )
    else:
        money_account = resolve_money_account(refund_method, bank_account)
        VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=money_account, credit=total_amount)

    if sale_return.cost_amount > ZERO:
        VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=_ensure_account("Inventory", Account.ASSET), debit=sale_return.cost_amount)
        VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=_ensure_account("Cost of Goods Sold", Account.EXPENSE), credit=sale_return.cost_amount)

    voucher.clean()
    sale_return.voucher = voucher
    sale_return.save(update_fields=["net_amount", "tax_amount", "total_amount", "cost_amount", "voucher"])
    record_audit(
        action="sale_return_created",
        description=f"Sale return #{sale_return.id} recorded for sale #{sale_obj.id}.",
        actor=actor,
        target=sale_return,
        metadata={"total_amount": str(sale_return.total_amount)},
    )
    return sale_return


@transaction.atomic
def create_purchase_return(*, purchase, quantities, settlement_method, reason, notes="", bank_account=None, actor=None):
    purchase_obj = (
        Purchase.objects.select_related("supplier")
        .prefetch_related("items__product", "items__return_items")
        .select_for_update()
        .get(pk=getattr(purchase, "pk", purchase))
    )

    if not (reason or "").strip():
        raise ValueError("Reason is required for purchase return.")
    if settlement_method == PurchaseReturn.PAYABLE and purchase_obj.supplier is None:
        raise ValueError("A supplier is required to reduce payable.")

    purchase_return = PurchaseReturn.objects.create(
        purchase=purchase_obj,
        supplier=purchase_obj.supplier,
        settlement_method=settlement_method,
        bank_account=bank_account,
        reason=reason.strip(),
        notes=notes,
        created_by=actor,
    )

    total_amount = ZERO
    items_map = {item.id: item for item in purchase_obj.items.all()}
    for item_id, qty in quantities.items():
        quantity = int(qty or 0)
        if quantity <= 0:
            continue
        item = items_map.get(int(item_id))
        if item is None:
            raise ValueError("One of the purchase items could not be found.")
        returnable = _purchase_item_returnable(item)
        if quantity > returnable:
            raise ValueError(f"Only {returnable} units of {item.product.name} can be returned.")
        if quantity > item.product.stock:
            raise ValueError(f"Current stock of {item.product.name} is not enough for this return.")

        line_amount = quantize_money(Decimal(item.cost_price or 0) * Decimal(quantity))
        PurchaseReturnItem.objects.create(
            purchase_return=purchase_return,
            purchase_item=item,
            product=item.product,
            quantity=quantity,
            line_amount=line_amount,
        )
        item.product.stock -= quantity
        item.product.save(update_fields=["stock"])
        total_amount += line_amount

    if not purchase_return.items.exists():
        raise ValueError("Select at least one return quantity.")

    purchase_return.total_amount = quantize_money(total_amount)
    voucher = Voucher.objects.create(
        voucher_type=Voucher.JOURNAL,
        date=timezone.localdate(),
        narration=f"Purchase return #{purchase_return.id} for purchase #{purchase_obj.id}",
        ref_model="PurchaseReturn",
        ref_id=purchase_return.id,
    )

    if settlement_method == PurchaseReturn.PAYABLE:
        VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=_ensure_account("Accounts Payable", Account.LIABILITY), debit=purchase_return.total_amount)
        PartyLedgerEntry.objects.create(
            voucher=voucher,
            content_type=ContentType.objects.get_for_model(purchase_obj.supplier),
            object_id=purchase_obj.supplier.id,
            debit=purchase_return.total_amount,
        )
    else:
        money_account = resolve_money_account(settlement_method, bank_account)
        VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=money_account, debit=purchase_return.total_amount)

    VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=_ensure_account("Inventory", Account.ASSET), credit=purchase_return.total_amount)
    voucher.clean()
    purchase_return.voucher = voucher
    purchase_return.save(update_fields=["total_amount", "voucher"])
    record_audit(
        action="purchase_return_created",
        description=f"Purchase return #{purchase_return.id} recorded for purchase #{purchase_obj.id}.",
        actor=actor,
        target=purchase_return,
        metadata={"total_amount": str(purchase_return.total_amount)},
    )
    return purchase_return

from decimal import Decimal

from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from accounts.models import Account, Voucher, VoucherLine
from accounts.services.audit import record_audit
from pos.models import Product, StockAdjustment, quantize_money


ZERO = Decimal("0.00")


def _ensure_account(title: str, account_type: str) -> Account:
    account, _ = Account.objects.get_or_create(title=title, defaults={"type": account_type})
    if account.type != account_type:
        raise ValueError(f"Account '{title}' exists with the wrong type.")
    if not account.is_active:
        account.is_active = True
        account.save(update_fields=["is_active"])
    return account


@transaction.atomic
def create_stock_adjustment(*, product, adjustment_mode, reason, quantity_after=None, quantity_delta=None, notes="", actor=None):
    product_obj = Product.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=getattr(product, "pk", product))
    quantity_before = int(product_obj.stock or 0)

    if not (reason or "").strip():
        raise ValueError("Reason is required for stock adjustment.")

    if adjustment_mode == StockAdjustment.STOCK_TAKE:
        if quantity_after in (None, ""):
            raise ValueError("Counted stock is required for stock take.")
        quantity_after = int(quantity_after)
        if quantity_after < 0:
            raise ValueError("Counted stock cannot be negative.")
        quantity_delta = quantity_after - quantity_before
    else:
        if quantity_delta in (None, ""):
            raise ValueError("Adjustment quantity is required.")
        quantity_delta = int(quantity_delta)
        quantity_after = quantity_before + quantity_delta
        if quantity_after < 0:
            raise ValueError("Adjustment would reduce stock below zero.")

    adjustment = StockAdjustment.objects.create(
        product=product_obj,
        adjustment_mode=adjustment_mode,
        quantity_before=quantity_before,
        quantity_after=quantity_after,
        quantity_delta=quantity_delta,
        reason=reason.strip(),
        notes=notes,
        created_by=actor,
    )

    product_obj.stock = quantity_after
    product_obj.save(update_fields=["stock"])

    value = quantize_money(Decimal(abs(quantity_delta)) * Decimal(product_obj.cost_price or 0))
    if quantity_delta != 0 and value > ZERO:
        inventory_account = _ensure_account("Inventory", Account.ASSET)
        if quantity_delta > 0:
            offset_account = _ensure_account("Inventory Adjustment Gain", Account.INCOME)
        else:
            offset_account = _ensure_account("Inventory Adjustment Loss", Account.EXPENSE)

        voucher = Voucher.objects.create(
            voucher_type=Voucher.JOURNAL,
            date=timezone.localdate(),
            narration=f"Stock adjustment #{adjustment.id} - {product_obj.name}",
            ref_model="StockAdjustment",
            ref_id=adjustment.id,
        )
        if quantity_delta > 0:
            VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=inventory_account, debit=value)
            VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=offset_account, credit=value)
        else:
            VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=offset_account, debit=value)
            VoucherLine.objects.create(voucher=voucher, account=inventory_account, credit=value)
        voucher.clean()
        adjustment.voucher = voucher
        adjustment.save(update_fields=["voucher"])

    record_audit(
        action="stock_adjusted",
        description=f"Stock for '{product_obj.name}' changed from {quantity_before} to {quantity_after}.",
        actor=actor,
        target=adjustment,
        metadata={"quantity_delta": quantity_delta, "adjustment_mode": adjustment_mode},
    )
    return adjustment

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
function getCsrfToken() {
    const match = document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/);
    return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : '';
}

function buildStatementUrl() {
    const from = document.getElementById('from_date').value;
    const to = document.getElementById('to_date').value;
    let url = `/api/party-statement/?customer_id={{ customer.id }}`;
    if (from) url += `&from=${from}`;
    if (to) url += `&to=${to}`;
    return url;
}

function loadStatement() {
    fetch(buildStatementUrl())
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            document.getElementById('closing_balance').innerText = `Rs ${data.closing_balance}`;
            const badge = document.getElementById('balance_badge');
            badge.className = `status-chip ${data.balance_type}`;
            badge.innerText = data.balance_type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
            const body = document.getElementById('ledger');
            body.innerHTML = '';
            data.rows.forEach(row => {
                body.innerHTML += `<tr>
                    <td>${row.date}</td>
                    <td>${row.voucher_type} #${row.voucher_id}</td>
                    <td>${row.ref}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.debit}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.credit}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.display_balance}</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
        });
}

function toggleBankLedger() {
    const method = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const wrap = document.getElementById('bank-ledger-wrap');
    wrap.classList.toggle('d-none', method !== 'bank');
}

function openSettlement() {
    toggleBankLedger();
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('settlementModal')).show();
}

function submitSettlement() {
    const method = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const payload = {
        customer_id: {{ customer.id }},
        amount: document.getElementById('amount').value,
        payment_method: method,
    };
    if (method === 'bank') {
        payload.bank_account_id = document.getElementById('bank_account_id').value;
    }

    fetch('/api/settlements/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': getCsrfToken(),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) {
            const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            throw new Error(data.error || 'Settlement could not be saved.');
        }
        window.location.reload();
    })
    .catch((error) => alert(error.message));
}

loadStatement();
</script>
{% endblock %}

    <div class="row g-3 mb-4">

        <div class="col-md-3"><input type="number" id="supplier_id" class="form-control" placeholder="Supplier ID"></div>
        <div class="col-md-2"><input type="date" id="from_date" class="form-control"></div>
        <div class="col-md-2"><input type="date" id="to_date" class="form-control"></div>
        <div class="col-md-2 d-grid"><button class="btn btn-dark" onclick="loadStatement()">Load</button></div>
    </div>

    <div id="summary" class="mb-4"></div>

    <div class="table-responsive">
        <table class="table table-sm align-middle mb-0" id="table" style="display:none;">
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>Date</th>
                    <th>Voucher</th>
                    <th>Ref</th>
                    <th class="text-end">Debit</th>
                    <th class="text-end">Credit</th>
                    <th class="text-end">Balance</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody></tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
function loadStatement() {
    const customer = document.getElementById('customer_id').value;
    const supplier = document.getElementById('supplier_id').value;
    const from = document.getElementById('from_date').value;
    const to = document.getElementById('to_date').value;

    let url = '/api/party-statement/?';
    if (customer) url += `customer_id=${customer}&`;
    if (supplier) url += `supplier_id=${supplier}&`;
    if (from) url += `from=${from}&`;
    if (to) url += `to=${to}&`;

    fetch(url)
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(renderStatement);
}

function renderStatement(data) {
    const summary = document.getElementById('summary');
    const table = document.getElementById('table');
    const body = table.querySelector('tbody');

    body.innerHTML = '';
    table.style.display = 'table';

    summary.innerHTML = `
        <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-3 align-items-center">
            <div><strong>Party:</strong> ${data.party}</div>
            <div><strong>Opening:</strong> ${data.opening_balance}</div>
            <div><strong>Closing:</strong> ${data.closing_balance}</div>
            <span class="status-chip ${data.balance_type}">${data.balance_type.toUpperCase()}</span>
        </div>
    `;

    data.rows.forEach(row => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td>${row.date}</td>
            <td>${row.voucher_type} #${row.voucher_id}</td>
            <td>${row.ref}</td>
            <td class="text-end">${row.debit}</td>
            <td class="text-end">${row.credit}</td>
            <td class="text-end">${row.display_balance}</td>
        `;
        body.appendChild(tr);
    });
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
function getCsrfToken() {
    const match = document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/);
    return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : '';
}

function buildStatementUrl() {
    const from = document.getElementById('from_date').value;
    const to = document.getElementById('to_date').value;
    let url = `/api/party-statement/?supplier_id={{ supplier.id }}`;
    if (from) url += `&from=${from}`;
    if (to) url += `&to=${to}`;
    return url;
}

function loadStatement() {
    fetch(buildStatementUrl())
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            document.getElementById('closing_balance').innerText = `Rs ${data.closing_balance}`;
            const badge = document.getElementById('balance_badge');
            badge.className = `status-chip ${data.balance_type}`;
            badge.innerText = data.balance_type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
            const body = document.getElementById('ledger');
            body.innerHTML = '';
            data.rows.forEach(row => {
                body.innerHTML += `<tr>
                    <td>${row.date}</td>
                    <td>${row.voucher_type} #${row.voucher_id}</td>
                    <td>${row.ref}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.debit}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.credit}</td>
                    <td class="text-end">${row.display_balance}</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
        });
}

function toggleBankLedger() {
    const method = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const wrap = document.getElementById('bank-ledger-wrap');
    wrap.classList.toggle('d-none', method !== 'bank');
}

function openSettlement() {
    toggleBankLedger();
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('settlementModal')).show();
}

function submitSettlement() {
    const method = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const payload = {
        supplier_id: {{ supplier.id }},
        amount: document.getElementById('amount').value,
        payment_method: method,
    };
    if (method === 'bank') {
        payload.bank_account_id = document.getElementById('bank_account_id').value;
    }

    fetch('/api/settlements/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': getCsrfToken(),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) {
            const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            throw new Error(data.error || 'Settlement could not be saved.');
        }
        window.location.reload();
    })
    .catch((error) => alert(error.message));
}

loadStatement();
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
    function toggleSidebar() {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
        const content = document.getElementById('content');
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        content.classList.toggle('expanded');
        localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
    }

    function toggleSidebarMobile() {
        document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('show');
        document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 992 && localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
            document.getElementById('content').classList.add('expanded');
        }
    });
</script>

FILE: pos/templates/pos/partials/_purchase_workspace_js.html
==============================================================================================================
﻿<script>
(function () {
    const totalFormsInput = document.getElementById('id_items-TOTAL_FORMS');
    const lineTemplate = document.getElementById('purchaseLineTemplate');
    const lineBody = document.getElementById('purchaseLinesBody');
    const addLineButton = document.getElementById('addPurchaseLineBtn');

    function bindRemoveButton(row) {
        const removeButton = row.querySelector('[data-remove-line]');
        if (!removeButton) {
            return;
        }
        removeButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const deleteInput = row.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"][name$="-DELETE"]');
            if (deleteInput) {
                deleteInput.checked = true;
            }
            row.classList.add('d-none');
        });
    }

    function addPurchaseLine() {
        if (!totalFormsInput || !lineTemplate || !lineBody) {
            return null;
        }

        const formIndex = Number(totalFormsInput.value);
        const markup = lineTemplate.innerHTML.replaceAll('__prefix__', String(formIndex));
        const wrapper = document.createElement('tbody');
        wrapper.innerHTML = markup.trim();
        const row = wrapper.querySelector('tr');
        if (!row) {
            return null;
        }

        lineBody.appendChild(row);
        totalFormsInput.value = String(formIndex + 1);
        bindRemoveButton(row);
        return row;
    }

    function appendOption(select, value, label, selected) {
        if (!select) {
            return;
        }

        const stringValue = String(value);
        let option = Array.from(select.options).find((item) => item.value === stringValue);
        if (!option) {
            option = document.createElement('option');
            option.value = stringValue;
            option.textContent = label;
            select.appendChild(option);
        } else {
            option.textContent = label;
        }

        if (selected) {
            select.value = stringValue;
        }
    }

    function visibleProductSelects() {
        return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('select[name$="-product"]')).filter(
            (select) => !select.closest('tr')?.classList.contains('d-none')
        );
    }

    function assignProductToPurchaseLine(product) {
        let targetSelect = visibleProductSelects().find((select) => !select.value);
        if (!targetSelect) {
            const newRow = addPurchaseLine();
            targetSelect = newRow ? newRow.querySelector('select[name$="-product"]') : null;
        }
        if (!targetSelect) {
            return;
        }

        appendOption(targetSelect, product.id, `${product.name} (${product.sku})`, true);
        const saleInput = targetSelect.closest('tr')?.querySelector('input[name$="-sale_price"]');
        if (saleInput && !saleInput.value) {
            saleInput.value = product.price;
        }
    }

    function setFeedback(form, messages, tone) {
        const feedback = form.querySelector('[data-form-feedback]');
        if (!feedback) {
            return;
        }

        if (!messages || messages.length === 0) {
            feedback.classList.add('d-none');
            feedback.textContent = '';
            feedback.className = 'small mt-2 d-none';
            return;
        }

        feedback.className = `small mt-2 ${tone === 'success' ? 'text-success' : 'text-danger'}`;
        feedback.classList.remove('d-none');
        feedback.innerHTML = messages.join('<br>');
    }

    function flattenErrors(errorMap) {
        const messages = [];
        Object.keys(errorMap || {}).forEach((key) => {
            (errorMap[key] || []).forEach((message) => messages.push(message));
        });
        return messages;
    }

    async function submitQuickForm(form) {
        const response = await fetch(form.action, {
            method: 'POST',
            body: new FormData(form),
            headers: {
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            },
        });

        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!response.ok) {
            setFeedback(form, flattenErrors(payload.errors || {}), 'error');
            return;
        }

        const kind = form.dataset.kind;
        if (kind === 'brand') {
            appendOption(document.getElementById('{{ quick_product_form.brand.id_for_label }}'), payload.brand.id, payload.brand.name, true);
            setFeedback(form, [`Brand "${payload.brand.name}" is ready for product creation.`], 'success');
        }

        if (kind === 'category') {
            appendOption(document.getElementById('{{ quick_product_form.category.id_for_label }}'), payload.category.id, payload.category.name, true);
            setFeedback(form, [`Category "${payload.category.name}" is ready for product creation.`], 'success');
        }

        if (kind === 'supplier') {
            appendOption(document.getElementById('{{ purchase_form.supplier.id_for_label }}'), payload.supplier.id, payload.supplier.name, true);
            appendOption(document.getElementById('{{ quick_product_form.supplier.id_for_label }}'), payload.supplier.id, payload.supplier.name, true);
            setFeedback(form, [`Supplier "${payload.supplier.name}" has been selected on this purchase.`], 'success');
        }

        if (kind === 'product') {
            document.querySelectorAll('select[name$="-product"]').forEach((select) => {
                appendOption(select, payload.product.id, `${payload.product.name} (${payload.product.sku})`, false);
            });
            assignProductToPurchaseLine(payload.product);
            setFeedback(form, [`Product "${payload.product.name}" is now available in the purchase lines.`], 'success');
        }

        form.reset();
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.purchase-line-row').forEach(bindRemoveButton);
    if (addLineButton) {
        addLineButton.addEventListener('click', addPurchaseLine);
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.quick-create-form').forEach((form) => {
        form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            submitQuickForm(form);
        });
    });
})();
</script>

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
(function () {
    const barcodeInput = document.getElementById('barcode-input');
    const productSearchInput = document.getElementById('product-search-input');
    const productSearchMeta = document.getElementById('product-search-meta');
    const productCards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.js-product-card'));
    const productSearchEmpty = document.getElementById('product-search-empty');
    const discountInput = document.getElementById('discount_rate');
    const taxInput = document.getElementById('tax_rate');
    const subtotalSpan = document.getElementById('subtotal-amount');
    const discountSpan = document.getElementById('discount-amount');
    const taxSpan = document.getElementById('tax-amount');
    const totalSpan = document.getElementById('final-total');
    const creditBox = document.getElementById('is_credit');
    const paymentMethod = document.getElementById('payment_method');
    const customerSelect = document.getElementById('customer_id');
    const customerHidden = document.getElementById('selected_customer_id_hidden');
    const bankSelect = document.getElementById('bank_account_id');
    const bankWrapper = document.getElementById('bank-account-wrapper');
    const preserveForms = document.querySelectorAll('.js-preserve-form');
    const cartLines = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cart-line'));
    const manualTaxEnabled = {{ manual_tax_enabled|yesno:"true,false" }};
    const usesCategoryGst = {{ uses_category_gst|yesno:"true,false" }};
    const inlineEditors = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-inline-pricing]'));

    function filterProducts() {
        if (!productSearchInput || !productCards.length) return;
        const term = productSearchInput.value.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        const parts = term ? term.split(' ').filter(Boolean) : [];
        let visibleCount = 0;
        const totalCount = productCards.length;

        productCards.forEach(function (card) {
            const haystack = (card.dataset.productSearch || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            const visible = !parts.length || parts.every(function (part) {
                return haystack.indexOf(part) !== -1;
            });
            card.classList.toggle('d-none', !visible);
            if (visible) visibleCount += 1;
        });

        if (productSearchEmpty) {
            productSearchEmpty.classList.toggle('d-none', visibleCount !== 0);
        }

        if (productSearchMeta) {
            productSearchMeta.textContent = term
                ? `Showing ${visibleCount} of ${totalCount} product${totalCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} while you type.`
                : `Showing all ${totalCount} available product${totalCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`;
        }
    }

    function validateInlinePricing(form) {
        const priceField = form.querySelector('[data-price-input]');
        const discountField = form.querySelector('[data-discount-input]');
        if (!priceField || !discountField) return true;
        const minimumValue = parseFloat(priceField.dataset.minimum || discountField.dataset.minimum || '0') || 0;
        const priceValue = parseFloat(priceField.value || '0') || 0;
        const discountValue = Math.min(Math.max(parseFloat(discountField.value || '0') || 0, 0), 100);
        const effectiveValue = priceValue - (priceValue * (discountValue / 100));
        const invalid = minimumValue > 0 && effectiveValue + 0.0001 < minimumValue;
        const message = invalid ? 'Below allowed pricing rule.' : '';
        priceField.setCustomValidity(message);
        discountField.setCustomValidity(message);
        return !invalid;
    }

    if (barcodeInput) {
        barcodeInput.focus();
        barcodeInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (event.key !== 'Enter') return;
            event.preventDefault();
            const code = barcodeInput.value.trim();
            if (!code) return;
            fetch(`/pos/ajax/scan/${encodeURIComponent(code)}/`)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.status === 'ok') {
                        window.location.reload();
                        return;
                    }
                    if (data.status === 'out_of_stock') {
                        alert(`${data.product} is out of stock for additional quantity.`);
                        return;
                    }
                    alert('Product not found.');
                });
            barcodeInput.value = '';
        });
    }

    function recalcTotal() {
        if (!subtotalSpan || !discountSpan || !taxSpan || !totalSpan) return;
        const rows = cartLines.map((line) => ({
            lineTotal: parseFloat(line.dataset.lineTotal) || 0,
            taxRate: parseFloat(line.dataset.taxRate) || 0,
        }));
        const subtotal = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.lineTotal, 0);
        let discountRate = parseFloat(discountInput ? discountInput.value : 0) || 0;
        let manualTaxRate = parseFloat(taxInput ? taxInput.value : 0) || 0;
        discountRate = Math.min(Math.max(discountRate, 0), 100);
        manualTaxRate = Math.min(Math.max(manualTaxRate, 0), 100);
        const discountAmount = subtotal * (discountRate / 100);
        const afterDiscount = subtotal - discountAmount;
        let taxAmount = 0;

        if (usesCategoryGst && subtotal > 0) {
            let remainingDiscount = discountAmount;
            rows.forEach((row, index) => {
                let allocatedDiscount = remainingDiscount;
                if (index < rows.length - 1) {
                    allocatedDiscount = Number((discountAmount * (row.lineTotal / subtotal)).toFixed(2));
                    remainingDiscount -= allocatedDiscount;
                }
                const taxableBase = Math.max(row.lineTotal - allocatedDiscount, 0);
                taxAmount += taxableBase * (row.taxRate / 100);
            });
        } else if (manualTaxEnabled) {
            taxAmount = afterDiscount * (manualTaxRate / 100);
        }

        subtotalSpan.textContent = subtotal.toFixed(2);
        discountSpan.textContent = discountAmount.toFixed(2);
        taxSpan.textContent = taxAmount.toFixed(2);
        totalSpan.textContent = (afterDiscount + taxAmount).toFixed(2);
    }

    function syncPreservedState(form) {
        const customerField = form.querySelector('input[name="selected_customer_id"]');
        const creditField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_credit"]');
        const paymentField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_payment_method"]');
        const bankField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_bank_account_id"]');
        const discountField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_discount_rate"]');
        const taxField = form.querySelector('input[name="preserve_tax_rate"]');
        if (customerField && customerSelect) customerField.value = customerSelect.value;
        if (creditField && creditBox) creditField.value = creditBox.checked ? '1' : '0';
        if (paymentField && paymentMethod) paymentField.value = paymentMethod.value;
        if (bankField && bankSelect) bankField.value = bankSelect.value;
        if (discountField && discountInput) discountField.value = discountInput.value;
        if (taxField && taxInput) taxField.value = taxInput.value;
    }

    function syncCheckoutCustomer() {
        if (customerHidden && customerSelect) customerHidden.value = customerSelect.value;
    }

    function toggleBankField() {
        if (!bankWrapper || !paymentMethod) return;
        const usingBank = paymentMethod.value === 'bank';
        const creditSale = creditBox && creditBox.checked;
        bankWrapper.style.display = usingBank && !creditSale ? '' : 'none';
        if ((!usingBank || creditSale) && bankSelect) bankSelect.value = '';
    }

    preserveForms.forEach(function (form) {
        form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
            syncPreservedState(form);
        });
    });

    inlineEditors.forEach(function (form) {
        const priceField = form.querySelector('[data-price-input]');
        const discountField = form.querySelector('[data-discount-input]');
        let submitTimer = null;

        const scheduleSubmit = function () {
            if (!validateInlinePricing(form)) return;
            window.clearTimeout(submitTimer);
            submitTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
                form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.submit();
            }, 450);
        };

        const flushSubmit = function () {
            if (!validateInlinePricing(form)) return;
            window.clearTimeout(submitTimer);
            form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.submit();
        };

        if (priceField && !priceField.readOnly) {
            priceField.addEventListener('input', scheduleSubmit);
            priceField.addEventListener('blur', flushSubmit);
        }
        if (discountField && !discountField.readOnly) {
            discountField.addEventListener('input', scheduleSubmit);
            discountField.addEventListener('blur', flushSubmit);
        }
        form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
            if (!validateInlinePricing(form)) {
                event.preventDefault();
            }
        });
        validateInlinePricing(form);
    });

    if (paymentMethod) paymentMethod.addEventListener('change', toggleBankField);
    if (creditBox) creditBox.addEventListener('change', toggleBankField);
    if (customerSelect) customerSelect.addEventListener('change', syncCheckoutCustomer);
    if (discountInput) discountInput.addEventListener('input', recalcTotal);
    if (taxInput) taxInput.addEventListener('input', recalcTotal);
    if (productSearchInput) {
        productSearchInput.addEventListener('input', filterProducts);
        productSearchInput.addEventListener('search', filterProducts);
    }

    syncCheckoutCustomer();
    toggleBankField();
    recalcTotal();
    filterProducts();
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
(function () {
    const form = document.getElementById("product-filter-form");
    if (!form) return;
    const queryInput = document.getElementById("q");
    const liveSelects = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll("select"));
    let timer = null;

    function submitForm() {
        form.requestSubmit ? form.requestSubmit() : form.submit();
    }

    if (queryInput) {
        queryInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
            window.clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = window.setTimeout(submitForm, 250);
        });
    }

    liveSelects.forEach(function (field) {
        field.addEventListener("change", submitForm);
    });
})();
</script>

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
    (function () {
        const modeField = document.getElementById("id_adjustment_mode");
        const reasonField = document.getElementById("id_reason_preset");
        const customReasonField = document.getElementById("id_custom_reason");
        const deltaWrap = document.querySelector(".quantity-delta-wrap");
        const afterWrap = document.querySelector(".quantity-after-wrap");
        const customWrap = document.querySelector(".custom-reason-wrap");

        function syncStockAdjustmentUi() {
            const mode = modeField ? modeField.value : "";
            const reason = reasonField ? reasonField.value : "";

            if (deltaWrap) {
                deltaWrap.style.display = mode === "stock_take" ? "none" : "block";
            }
            if (afterWrap) {
                afterWrap.style.display = mode === "stock_take" ? "block" : "none";
            }
            if (customWrap) {
                customWrap.style.display = reason === "other" ? "block" : "none";
            }
            if (mode === "stock_take" && reasonField && !reasonField.value) {
                reasonField.value = "stock_take_difference";
            }
            if (reason !== "other" && customReasonField) {
                customReasonField.value = customReasonField.value || "";
            }
        }

        if (modeField) {
            modeField.addEventListener("change", syncStockAdjustmentUi);
        }
        if (reasonField) {
            reasonField.addEventListener("change", syncStockAdjustmentUi);
        }
        syncStockAdjustmentUi();
    })();
</script>
{% endblock %}

from django import template
import barcode
from barcode.writer import ImageWriter
from io import BytesIO
import base64
from django.utils.safestring import mark_safe

register = template.Library()

@register.simple_tag
def barcode_image(sku, width=100):
    """
    Generate a Code128 barcode image (inline base64).
    """
    try:
        EAN = barcode.get_barcode_class("code128")
        ean = EAN(sku, writer=ImageWriter())
        buffer = BytesIO()
        ean.write(buffer)
        b64 = base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode("utf-8")
        return mark_safe(f'<img src="data:image/png;base64,{b64}" width="{width}">')
    except Exception:
        return ""

from django import template
from decimal import Decimal

register = template.Library()

@register.filter
def get_item(d, key):
    try:
        return d.get(str(key), 0)
    except Exception:
        return 0

@register.filter
def multiply(a, b):
    try:
        return Decimal(a) * Decimal(b)
    except Exception:
        return 0

class AuthenticatedAdminTestCase(TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        super().setUpTestData()
        ensure_role_groups()

            password="AdminPass123!",

            last_name="Admin",
            is_staff=True,
        )
        assign_role(cls.admin_user, ADMIN_ROLE)

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.client.force_login(self.admin_user)
